Q5028.reason: A brochure claim and a recorded plat that only proposes a school site create neither a covenant, an equitable servitude, nor an accepted public easement, so the designation is unenforceable.

Q5787.reason: Stipulated intent to inflict only a slight wound is not malice aforethought, that battery intent transfers, and an unintended killing in the course of the unlawful act is involuntary manslaughter.

Q5115.reason: At exercise onset glycolysis accelerates and forms pyruvate faster than mitochondria can oxidize it, so lactate production rises; lactate cannot form if pyruvate is never made.
